description: This file contains SwiftUI views and related components for rendering chat messages, including message bubbles, tool call cards, typing indicators, and associated styling and layout logic within a chat UI.

classes.name: ChatBubbleShape
classes.description: Custom shape for chat message bubbles with optional tails (left, right, none).

classes.name: ChatMessageBubble
classes.description: Main view for displaying a chat message bubble, including styling based on user or assistant role.

classes.name: ChatMessageBody
classes.description: Internal view rendering the content of a chat message, including text, attachments, tool calls, and results.

classes.name: AttachmentRow
classes.description: View for displaying an attachment within a chat message.

classes.name: ToolCallCard
classes.description: View representing a tool call within a chat message.

classes.name: ToolResultCard
classes.description: View for displaying the result of a tool execution.

classes.name: ChatTypingIndicatorBubble
classes.description: View showing a typing indicator with animated dots.

classes.name: ChatStreamingAssistantBubble
classes.description: View for streaming assistant responses with markdown rendering.

classes.name: ChatAssistantTextBody
classes.description: Render assistant message text with markdown segments.

methods.name: inset(by:)
methods.description: Returns an inset shape with specified amount.

methods.name: path(in:)
methods.description: Generates the path for the chat bubble shape with optional tail.

methods.name: rightTailPath(in:radius:)
methods.description: Creates path for right tail chat bubble.

methods.name: leftTailPath(in:radius:)
methods.description: Creates path for left tail chat bubble.

methods.name: addBottomEdge(path:bubbleMinX:bubbleMaxX:bubbleMaxY:radius:)
methods.description: Adds bottom edge curves to bubble path.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Main view rendering the chat message bubble with content and styling.

methods.name: primaryText
methods.description: Extracts main text content from message.

methods.name: inlineAttachments
methods.description: Filters message content for attachments.

methods.name: toolCalls
methods.description: Filters message content for tool call elements.

methods.name: inlineToolResults
methods.description: Filters message content for tool result elements.

methods.name: isToolResultMessage
methods.description: Checks if message role indicates a tool result.

methods.name: toolResultTitle
methods.description: Generates title for tool result display.

methods.name: bubbleFillColor
methods.description: Determines bubble fill color based on message role and style.

methods.name: bubbleBackground
methods.description: Returns background style for bubble.

methods.name: bubbleBorderColor
methods.description: Determines border color for bubble.

methods.name: bubbleBorderWidth
methods.description: Determines border width for bubble.

methods.name: bubbleBorder
methods.description: Creates border overlay for bubble shape.

methods.name: bubbleShape
methods.description: Creates shape for chat bubble with tail.

methods.name: bubbleTail
methods.description: Determines tail position based on style and role.

methods.name: tailPaddingLeading
methods.description: Padding for tail on leading side.

methods.name: tailPaddingTrailing
methods.description: Padding for tail on trailing side.

methods.name: bubbleShadowColor
methods.description: Shadow color for bubble.

methods.name: bubbleShadowRadius
methods.description: Shadow radius for bubble.

methods.name: bubbleShadowYOffset
methods.description: Vertical offset for bubble shadow.
